findings.message: 1 headline(s) switch typeface or to italic mid-line (the "one italic serif word" move).
findings.fix: Set the whole headline in one face. Emphasis comes from the words.

findings.message: Monospace type outside code: IBM Plex Mono — e.g. "python", "sql", "statistics", "tableau"
findings.fix: Set it in the text face. Monospace is for literal code inside <pre>/<code> only.
Use the drawn palette. If you want warmth, take a low-chroma stone or bone, not a yellow cream.
A page needs about five: display, heading, lead, body, small.

findings.message: No video anywhere on the page.
findings.fix: Look for one honest clip with scripts/assets.mjs --video (the place, the material, the process) and use it as a muted loop with a poster frame. Defend its absence only if no clip fits the subject.

findings.message: Pinned large text slides across pictures while the page scrolls: "Your skills," (screen 1, 100% over a picture); "matched." (screen 1, 100% over a picture)
findings.fix: Jurors read a pinned title crossing drawings or photographs as a collision. Keep the pictures in the column the title does not occupy, or unpin it.

findings.message: The same large text stays on screen for 3 screens in a row: "How a match is made"; "Read."
findings.fix: A pinned element earns two screens, and something must change at each. Shorten the run or give every screen its own content.

findings.message: With reduced motion requested, 10 text block(s) on the first screen stay invisible: "0.05", "0.10", "0.15", "0.20"
findings.fix: Put every hidden starting state inside @media (prefers-reduced-motion: no-preference); the reduced page is the finished page (references/motion.md §8).
